name: Mondince FM316
why_interesting: Featured in ChineseCarbon top posts; an aero gravel frame with internal storage.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Manufacturer: 1,030±30 g XS raw; 1,150 g M raw. The manufacturer method page defines range weights as size-M raw, unpainted carbon, excluding paint, decals and hardware. Downtube storage cover is separately listed at 42 g, but whether it is included in 1,150 g is unstated.
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer 700C × 50 mm maximum; confirm actual fit and fork option
facts.included_package: Frame, fork, seatpost, axles, headset and bag; exact FM316 sheet identifies 395 mm A-C fork with 45/50 mm flip chip. Confirm this fork in the selected order.
facts.availability_evidence: Current manufacturer FAQ permits MOQ 1 for private standard-color orders, while Factory Capacity states MOQ 30 and the page advises checking availability. A recent owner report says a size-M frame arrived the previous week; an older report describes a past two-frame order. Seller, dates, channel and current single-unit stock/reorder status remain unknown.

official_price.price_basis: Mondince's 2026 comparative guide lists the FM316 frameset at US$1,050, converted using the ECB reference cross-rate.
official_price.conditions: Foreign guide reference only; the product page remains quote-on-request and selected package, size, finish, stock, mainland price, shipping, tax, duties and actual transaction rate are unverified.

missing: Exact individual-order mainland delivered quote and selected stock

Exact-frame stiffness measurement or named comparative ride evidence
source_note:
Weight headline now has an M-size basis and can coexist with the XS detailed value. Package is specified. Individual fulfilment remains conflicted; foreign guide and historical owner prices are not mainland observations.

Batch 36 recheck: manufacturer method page defines range weights as size-M raw, unpainted carbon, excluding paint, decals and hardware. Exact FM316 page lists 1,150 g at M and a separate 42 g storage cover; it does not say whether that cover is included in the 1,150 g.

Batch 52 recheck (2026-09-24): the exact product page now states a typical single frameset range of US$500–650 and welcomes individual orders; a separate bulk section states MOQ 30. This conflicts with the prior US$1,050 official guide reference. Both are foreign references and no mainland CNY price or selected package is established.

Batch 55 recheck (2026-09-24): distinct public mainland marketplace searches returned no exact FM316 item. A foreign German-language MyBike.parts search result displayed USD $509 but routed to Mondince's foreign store; it is not a mainland offer and was not recorded as observed price.

Batch 64 (2026-09-24): a recent public community post reports receipt of a size-M FM316 and a completed build, but its live relative-age display conflicts with its indexed date and it gives no order date, seller, market, explicit quantity or current reorder option. Record this as community-reported recent delivery only; current single-unit availability remains unknown.

Batch 65 recheck (2026-09-25): current official page retains MOQ 1 private-order and MOQ 30 factory text plus an availability-check banner. The recent and older owner reports establish past/recent deliveries only, not current reorder terms.
